name: ea-cc-probe
title: Earth build compat-completeness probe (test only)
author: Jake Mismas
description: Test tool, never shipped. Its jobs, read once in on_init from the runtime-global setting ea-cc-probe-job, force-generate fixed areas of Nauvis and write each area's tile, entity and decorative name counts, resource amounts and per-chunk digests (census), or write every surface's planet, property_expression_names and named tile properties read at the origin (surfaces). Output goes to script-output/ea-cc-probe/.
